quests.title: Dreamlike

dialogue.t: That was pretty fun... Huh? What's that?
Paimon doesn't remember seeing that before. When did that show up?
This looks like part of Akitsu Yuugei too... Should we go take a closer look? Paimon will let you decide.
Paimon wonders what it's like inside. Let's go in and take a look!

quests.description: After experiencing the Akitsu Yuugei, a mysterious doorway suddenly appeared nearby…
